name: David Dickinson
bio: a Representative from Tennessee; born in Franklin, Tenn., June 10, 1808; completed preparatory studies and graduated from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill; studied law; admitted to the bar and practiced; elected as a Jacksonian candidate to the Twenty-third Congress (March 4, 1833-March 3, 1835); elected as a Whig to the Twenty-eighth Congress (March 4, 1843-March 3, 1845); was unable to attend the last session of Congress on account of his failing health; died at "Grantland," his father's home, near Murfreesboro, Rutherford County, Tenn., on April 27, 1845; interment in the family burying ground on the estate.
